hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels with validateQuantityAtLocation compares each input entry against level.available_quantity separately and never sums entries that share (inventory_item_id, location_id). Two carts that each hold WIDGET on multiple lines, released together on one server, can both pass the per-line check against the same level and push reserved beyond stock. With stock 10, cart A holds 5 x OVS-PIECE and cart B holds 3 x OVS-PIECE plus 2 x OVS-TWOPACK (4 units). Each line of B is at most 5 available after A reserves, so B passes, and no_oversell should fail in some runs. Expect at least some failing runs; this is the race the report describes.
